modified_C2_collar_bar_hold.reason: Every prior C2 assumes inaccessible pre-glue receiver/carrier/cap assembly. Restored debond channels do not fix post-glue reversibility.
modified_C2_collar_bar_hold.required_gate: Complete forward and reverse assembly from bare already-glued bar; every other component and hardware installed and removed through the root opening after glue.
modified_C2_collar_bar_hold.old_artifacts: Preserve unchanged; none of the previous collar/bar packages is approved.

ball_interface.added_external_geometry_policy: outside original bar radial profile, remain below opening with chosen setback
ball_interface.original_channels_purpose: bottom-fed alcohol/debond-fluid passages, not lateral tool ports
ball_interface.channel_preservation_baseline: exact original empty channel geometry, not a selected minimum flow width
ball_interface.debond_fluid_access_scope: Operator confirmed access after the detachable cup/collar module is removed is sufficient

mounting_workflow.removable_joint: baseplate to bar, operated from below
mounting_workflow.accepted_order_A: preset knob grip; lock baseplate into ball/bar; then seat and secure stock hex in box
mounting_workflow.accepted_order_B: seat and secure stock hex in box, fitting knob/baseplate as access permits; then lock ball/bar to baseplate from below
mounting_workflow.stationary_bearing_role_if_used: passive support, not a separate retaining joint
mounting_workflow.cup_grip_adjustment: with ball/bar removed; side grip screws are exposed again after underside ball removal
mounting_workflow.glued_ball_attachment_and_removal: All operations reversible from root; lateral exterior above root inaccessible
mounting_workflow.receiver_repair_access: Every removable receiver, cap, nut, screw and collar must be retrievable through root after glue
mounting_workflow.routine_tool_halfspace_check: New candidates require actual axial staging and operating swept-volume checks
mounting_workflow.initial_condition: Bare printed bar already glued inside ball; every other collar/baseplate component and loose fastener outside ball
mounting_workflow.final_service_condition: Bare glued bar, all other coupling components and hardware removed without debonding
